chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan, from Abdullah ibn Khidash Al-Minqari, that he asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him)
about a man who died and left his daughter and his brother. He (peace be upon him) said: 'The wealth is for the daughter.'
ai.seo_question: Who inherits the estate if a deceased man leaves only a daughter and a brother?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the principle of 'blocking' (hadr) in Shia inheritance jurisprudence, where the presence of a closer heir (the daughter) excludes a more distant one (the brother) from the estate. It highlights the distinct Shia interpretation of the Quranic verses on inheritance, emphasizing the daughter's right to the full share when no sons or parents are present, thereby excluding collateral relatives like brothers.
